description: Original deterministic layered Cartesian value fields, domain-warped mainland/coast and lake masks, mountain belts with foothills, latitude/moisture terrain, compatible resource provinces and bounded graph-based starting-region selection. Adjacent capital worked plots are reserved before resource balancing; compatible Plains deposits preserve combined food and production yields even in tiny regions. No external noise implementation or Unciv map-generator code is copied. This is an original civilization ruleset generator with intentional differences from upstream; it is not an Unciv parity implementation. Existing saved tile records are unaffected by generation changes.
